name: Claim origin group return routing

dataIsolation.guard: Persist and resolve only the tenant-scoped opaque actual-origin reference; never expose or guess a raw LINE group ID.

definitionOfDone: A legacy claim records the actual LINE origin separately from its accounting source
Return events resolve the immutable origin reference through Claims Authority
Inactive, missing, malformed, or mismatched recipients fail closed
Older claims retain the previous source-group fallback
